name: CSU Digital S.A.
summary: CSU Digital S.A. is a Brazilian fintech specializing in comprehensive digital solutions for the financial services sector. The company delivers offerings across payments, embedded finance, customer experience, and loyalty and incentive programs. Its operations are structured around two core segments: CSU Pays and CSU DX. The CSU Pays segment concentrates on digital payment solutions, loyalty schemes, and embedded financial services, encompassing credit, debit, digital, and virtual card processing for both issuers and acquirers, alongside digital wallets, instant payment systems, and cryptocurrency services. The CSU DX segment is dedicated to crafting advanced digital experience solutions, emphasizing technologically sophisticated and complex projects that deliver significant added value. Beyond these primary areas, CSU Digital provides a suite of complementary services, including the development and operational management of customer relationship and acquisition programs, electronic transaction services for businesses, IT outsourcing, and banking correspondent services for financial institutions. Its capabilities further extend to managing and operating telemarketing and telesales contact centers, conducting credit analysis, processing electronic payment transactions, and overseeing credit card administration, issuance, and payment account management solutions. Established in 1992, the company rebranded from CSU CardSystem S.A. to CSU Digital S.A. in August 2022. Headquartered in Barueri, Brazil, it operates as a subsidiary of Greeneville Delaware LLC.
